captions.diagnosis: Local drift, not fast speech. The film averages 13.6 chars/s and the worst cue runs at 47; the 15 cues under 9 cps are the other half of the same error, words held too long where others were rushed. Alignment confidence is lower on the dense cues (0.352 vs 0.590) but only 1 of the 39 is in the near-zero band, so confidence is a contributing signal and not the whole cause.
